findings.condition: Real add paused after alternate-index write and durable write-completed, before checkpoint tree/ref. Fixture-only loose blob B had its mtime explicitly set to 2000-01-01; native GC prune=now and pack-refs ran while no Git child was active.
findings.command: absolute git gc --prune=now; git pack-refs --all; resume real managed add
findings.expected: Observe real object reachability and require an explicit failure or a valid retained result; do not assume private index is a GC root.
findings.observed: Git prunes B because current refs and the main index do not retain it. The resumed writer fails GIT_FAILED, rolls back its private index to A and preserves B workspace bytes, refs and base. Status after rollback is healthy.
